auditor: independent recompute from shipped artifacts (lifelines Cox / log-rank), not manifest trust

summary.headline: The prognostic FAP/CXCL10 fingerprint is genuinely validated cross-cohort (6 cohorts, n=1,236, HR 0.677, p=2e-4). The tier survival-separation system does NOT replicate externally. The advertised '16 cohorts / 2,444 patients validated' is not backed by any shipped artifact. The manuscript CXCL12/POSTN predictive model is absent from deployed code and is INCONCLUSIVE where tested.

C1_fingerprint_prognostic_pooled.claim: FAP_z<0 & CXCL10_z>0 fingerprint is prognostic for OS across cohorts
C1_fingerprint_prognostic_pooled.method: Cox PH stratified by cohort (lifelines), recomputed from shipped cross_cohort_fingerprint_pooled.csv

C2_tier_survival_separation.claim: 3-tier (TIER_1/2/3) system separates survival in external cohorts
C2_tier_survival_separation.note: Tier survival-separation did NOT replicate externally in ANY cohort with a usable log-rank statistic: 5/5 external cohorts fail (all p>=0.05, none significant); 0 cohorts hold. The remaining 3 manifests carry no usable log-rank p (CPTAC/MSK/stub) and cannot verify a positive claim. Relabeled discovery/exploratory.
C2_tier_survival_separation.method: Robust re-scan of all validation_manifest*.json, keyed on presence of a usable log-rank p (metadata-independent).

C3_advertised_16_cohorts_2444.claim: config.py VALIDATION_CTX: cohorts_validated=16, patients_validated=2444, framed as validated
C3_advertised_16_cohorts_2444.note: No shipped artifact demonstrates a 16-cohort / 2444-patient validation. The strongest real evidence is the 6-cohort/n=1236 prognostic Cox. The '16/2444 validated' framing is not backed by a matching artifact and conflates prognostic signal with tier/predictive validation.

C4_predictive_model_deployment.claim: The manuscript headline CXCL12/POSTN predictive platinum-response model is deployed
C4_predictive_model_deployment.manuscript_verdict: INCONCLUSIVE (GSE63885 OOD AUROC 0.638, 95%CI 0.513-0.764, p=0.031; nested-CV 0.592+/-0.112; EPV~0.36)
C4_predictive_model_deployment.note: Deployed PLATINUM_SCORE is the FAP/CXCL10 PROGNOSTIC model. The CXCL12/POSTN PREDICTIVE model is absent. Being added as a new distinct axis (W2), labeled INCONCLUSIVE + calibration-required.

C5_label_certainty.claim: Platinum-response labels are well-populated for TCGA reference
C5_label_certainty.note: Only 9 TCGA patients have confirmed platinum-response labels (all sensitive). Already disclosed in shipped audit; not a hidden gap, but limits any TCGA-based platinum-response calibration.
